model: GATEWAY / GATEWAY-S multi-circuit meter (mixed configuration example)
applies_to: Triacta GATEWAY and GATEWAY-S modular multi-circuit sub-meters with the BACnet IP interface.
summary: The GATEWAY / GATEWAY-S builds its BACnet IP object list from the meter configuration: each configured meter point gets Analog Inputs for power, power factor and demand, each element gets current, voltage, power, power factor and angle, and energy registers and pulse inputs are Accumulator objects. This list is the printed "mixed configuration" example (16 meter points, 36 elements, 12 pulse inputs); a different set-up gives a different list and numbering.
notes: From the "BACnet Mixed Configuration Output" table of the application note (document pages 8-16). Instances are assigned in order of the configured meter points, so they shift with the configuration.
Only configured meter points and pulse inputs appear; the doc gives a maximum of 768 measurement objects and 48 pulse objects.
Energy registers and pulse counters are BACnet Accumulator objects. Pulse counters need the Pulses report type enabled.
Demand objects need Peak / Present Demand enabled in the configuration tool. Units are taken from the per-meter and per-element description tables.
The doc also prints a single-meter-point example (AI 0-21, ACC 0-4) that follows the same pattern; it is not listed separately.
There is no access column; all objects are read-only measurements.

integration.summary: Configure the meter points and report types in the Triacta Configuration Tool, set a unique device ID, then discover the meter over BACnet IP and read power, demand and the energy Accumulators for each meter point.
setup: Device ID 0-4194303 (default 4194303); UDP port default 47808. Set both in the BACnet tab of the Triacta Configuration Tool.
For networks across subnets, enter a BBMD address; the meter registers as a foreign device (BBMD timeout default 60000 s).
gotchas: Segmentation is not supported: use ReadProperty or small ReadPropertyMultiple requests, never read-all.
Object instances depend on which meter points are configured; re-check the object list after any configuration change.
All times are reported in UTC (UTC offset fixed at 0).
